finding: init-factory creates .agent-factory/usage/records/. Capture writes its records directly into .agent-factory/usage/, and the analysis reads only that level, so records/ stays empty. Source: bug-hunt report § Found while fixing(../reviews/bug-hunt-2026-10-15.md#found-while-fixing). Fix: Either write records into records/ and read them from there, or stop creating the directory. Pick the option that keeps existing records readable.
why_this_severity: `init-factory` creates `.agent-factory/usage/records/`, and capture writes one level above it, so the directory stays empty and a reader looks in the wrong place. Capture and analysis work without the directory (no to fails_purpose).
